title: Zac Brown's 11.5-acre farm feeds campers at Georgia charity supporting children and veterans
summary_full: Founded by Zac Brown in 2011, Camp Southern Ground is a beacon of inclusivity for children and veterans. Spanning 400 acres, its campus includes an organic farm that not only provides nutritious meals but also offers educational initiatives. Over the years, Camp Southern Ground has evolved to enhance support for military families, using a rounded approach that fosters personal growth through food, outdoor activities, and community engagement.
